name: regdata-platform
description: Regulatory Data Analytics Platform — React + Node.js (NestJS) monorepo

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @regdata/contracts && npm run build -w @regdata/field-rules
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @regdata/api && npm run build -w @regdata/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @regdata/api" "npm run dev -w @regdata/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
